notes: Cloudflare Pages is the right starting point — free, fast global CDN, easy HTTPS.
Phases 2-4 build on the same Cloudflare infrastructure using Workers and a backend.
Phase 2 complete: KV subscriber storage live. Admin can view/export subscribers.
Phase 3 pivoted to Cloudflare Workers + D1 (free tier). Revenue-first: on-site Flutterwave payments.
D1 free tier: 5GB storage, 5M reads/mo, 100k writes/mo — enough for early revenue phase.
Flutterwave payouts are settled to your bank in Ghana (GHS). No monthly fee, only per-transaction 1.4% + GHS 1.
Page renamed from Roadmap → ToDo List. Agentic Task Management system live — AI-created tasks persist in D1.
Phase 8 started early (8.1 done) because the agent needs to track its own work.
Phase 5 — Fix The Cash Register must be completed before Phase 6 (Profit Engine).
When Phase 6 revenue justifies it, migrate heavy workloads to a paid VPS with Postgres.

Phase 7 — Strategic Offensive: Infrastructure built (partners page, press kit, content library, sitemap.xml, JSON-LD, referral API, share-to-unlock). Pre-launch SEO checklist added: submit to Google/Bing/Yandex, structured data validation, technical audit, meta tag audit, page speed audit. Post-launch monitoring checklist: weekly GSC checks, monthly content publishing, monthly backlink tracking, quarterly performance reviews, bi-annual content refresh.

Phase 9 — Audit Fixes & Site Polish: 12 items to fix from the full site audit. Store fulfillment, nationbuilding links, Systems Thinking enrollable, prompt()→modal, newsletter archive, music links, art inventory, merch sizing, 404 duplicate og:url, Flutterwave preconnect, CSP header, formatPrice guard.
Phase 10 — Smoke Tests: Run after every deployment. Click Verify Live on the admin page to auto-check all items against live URLs.
Admin /admin/submissions.html page is a static placeholder — needs live data integration from D1 contact_submissions table.

Dashboard (11.2), agents CRUD (11.3), workflow engine (11.4), queue processor (11.5), run history (11.6), settings/preferences (11.7), auth consolidation (11.8), D1-wired submissions (11.9), live architecture diagram (11.10), mobile/UX polish (11.11).
